embeds.title: DBL OWNER HANDBOOK
embeds.description: Everything an owner needs week to week, in one place. The Constitution has the full rules; section numbers are in brackets.

fields.name: DAILY LINEUPS
fields.value: Set your lineup in Fantrax every day. Each player locks about one minute before his MLB game (5.3). Active slots: C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, 3 OF, 2 UTIL (any hitter), 5 SP and 3 RP (6.2).

fields.name: PITCHER STARTS
fields.value: A maximum of 7 pitcher starts count each Week, and 14 across the two-week Championship (9.2, 9.3). The live scoreboard shows how many starts each team has used.

fields.name: MINORS AND IL
fields.value: 15 minors spots for players with no more than 130 career MLB at-bats and 50 career MLB innings (7.2). When a player stops qualifying you have 3 days to move him (7.4). Up to 4 IL spots. An illegal roster must be fixed within 24 hours (6.4).

fields.name: FAAB AND ADDS
fields.value: $1,000 FAAB each Season. Bids are hidden, in $1 steps, and $0 is allowed; the earliest bid wins a tie. Claims process daily around 11:00 AM ET. Up to 5 acquisitions per Week (Article X).

fields.name: TRADES AND PICKS
fields.value: No votes or vetoes. The deadline is Sunday 11:59 PM ET at the end of Week 20 (11.6). To trade away a future 1st- or 2nd-round pick, your dues must be paid through that pick's Season first, or the trade is reversed (Article XII).

fields.name: STAY IN THE LOOP
fields.value: Turn on notifications in the Fantrax app so you hear about trades, claims and lineup problems. Type `/link` for the League Calendar on your phone. Pick your notification roles under **Channels & Roles**.

fields.name: LEAGUE BOT (2027 ON)
fields.value: `/myteam` your roster, picks and next matchup • `/minor` a player's eligibility • `/rule` any section • `/deadlines` the next dates • `/tradecheck` a trade against the rules • Pick'em in **⚾│game-day**.

fields.name: QUESTIONS
fields.value: Rules questions go to **❓│rules-questions**. Anything private goes to **🎟️│open-a-ticket**.
